finding.description: World cache identity includes geometry key and extent but does not bind the originating NativeMetal owner. A later prepare with another owner may reuse buffers, pipeline and targets from the previous owner. UI texture device validation alone cannot prove matching mesh, pipeline and budget ownership.
finding.required: Reject owner mismatch before collection or cache mutation; reject diagnostic submission through another owner; retain a wrong-owner refusal control proving previous frame remains intact.

reviewed_positive_properties: Complete Prepared owner retained through UI sampling
World encoding precedes UI sampling in the same command buffer
Target pool bounded to three retained targets
Native texture size queried before budget admission
remaining: Actual native SDK shader compilation and GPU execution
Full source paint policies and production viewport integration
Physical Mac and ARM presentation acceptance
